title: Cowboys, Babies and Shotgun Vows
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: A one-volume Harlequin manga adapted from a Shirley Rogerson novel. Rancher and playboy Ryder helps a drunk young woman from a bar to a motel; they spend the night together and she leaves, and he learns she is an oil tycoon's daughter. He sets out to find her, and MangaUpdates tags indicate a pregnancy and an engagement follow.
life_message: A careless night can become lasting love and family when both people take responsibility.
